title: The Collapse of Heterogeneity in Silicon Philosophers

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM-generated philosophical stances conditioned on academic profiles (Areas of Specialization/Interest) against ground-truth human survey responses to identify spurious or amplified expert stereotypes (e.g., assuming an Ancient Philosophy scholar automatically holds Aristotelian views).

Correlating LLM-generated survey responses with the simulated philosopher's PhD institution country to test whether models inappropriately anchor on regional stereotypes when predicting philosophical viewpoints.
Measuring correlations between the simulated philosopher's PhD graduation year and their generated philosophical positions to identify whether the models amplify temporal or generational stereotypes.
